svg.aria-label: Two columns, the same four facts. Left, the problem: three Monday asks are forgotten, the weekly limit is nearly spent on Thursday, a feature called done never ran, and rules live in the prompt where the model can forget them. Right, what Budgit does: a ledger keeps the asks, four levels pace the week, a fresh reviewer tests before done, and guards are scripts
